name: BUTALBITAL, ASPIRIN, AND CAFFEINE
indications_original: Butalbital, Aspirin, and Caffeine Capsules is indicated for the relief of the symptom complex of tension (or muscle contraction) headache. y and safety of Butalbital, Aspirin, and Caffeine Capsules in the treatment of multiple recurrent headaches is unavailable. Caution in this regard is required because butalbital is habit-forming and potentially abusable.
contraindications_original: One or 2 capsules every 4 hours. Total daily dose should not exceed 6 capsules. Extended and repeated use of this product is not recommended because of the potential for physical dependence.
adverseReactions_original:
Butalbital, Aspirin, and Caffeine Capsules is contraindicated under the following conditions:
                  
                     Hypersensitivity or intolerance to aspirin, caffeine, or butalbital.
                     Patients with a hemorrhagic diathesis (e.g., hemophilia, hypoprothrombinemia, von Willebrand's disease, the thrombocytopenias, thrombasthenia and other ill-defined hereditary platelet dysfunctions, severe vitamin K deficiency and severe liver damage).
                     Patients with the syndrome of nasal polyps, angioedema and bronchospastic reactivity to aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Anaphylactoid reactions have occurred in such patients.
                     Peptic ulcer or other serious gastrointestinal lesions.
                     Patients with porphyria.
